$comment: Allow-list for scripts/ci/check-anon-exposure-live.mjs — the scheduled sweep that
reads PRODUCTION and asks: which relations does the public `anon` key reach?
This file is NOT a blanket pardon. Two statuses, and they behave differently:
approved      — a human ruled on it. Silent unless it disappears.
grandfathered — exposed when the sweep was built (2026-07-29), never explicitly
ruled on. Reported every run as a WARN so it is not forgotten,
and ESCALATED TO A HARD FAILURE if it ever gains rows while
carrying an identity column (learner_id / user_id / email / …).
That escalation is the point. pde_certificates, pde_learner_badges and
pde_reputation all carry learner_id and hold 0 rows today. A plain allow-list
would bless them forever, and the first certificate PDE ever issues would be
public with nothing to notice it. rows_at_grandfather is the tripwire.
TO ADD AN ENTRY: state a reason a stranger can evaluate, and prefer `approved`
only when someone actually decided. Guessing here disarms the sweep.
